title: Post-Termination Stock-Option Exercise-Window Decision
description: Decide whether to exercise vested options inside the post-termination window. Models exercise cost, spread, AMT flag, and EV of exercise-and-hold vs. lapse across exit scenarios.
data_vintage: 2026 — no embedded data tables; AMT via AL-116
regulatory_citations: IRC §422 — ISO post-termination exercise window (default 90 days)
IRC §83 — ordinary income treatment on NSO spread at exercise

mcp_tool_definition.name: evaluate_option_exercise_window
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model whether to exercise vested stock options before the post-termination expiration window, including exercise cost, spread, AMT exposure flag, and expected value across exit scenarios.
